result.topic_en: Calculation with two first-order partial differential equations in p and q (with coefficients involving u and a), rewritten for pairs of solutions (π, χ) and (π', χ'), and derivation of a formula for the logarithmic derivative of the determinant πχ' − χπ'.
result.transcription:
$4a\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial m\partial \eta}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial \eta}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial \eta}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial \eta}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$
$4a\frac{\partial^2 q}{\partial m\partial \eta}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial \eta}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial \eta}+2\frac{u+a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial \eta}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$
Ansatz[?]
$4a\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\pi-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\chi+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\pi=0$ $\quad 4a\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial m}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\pi-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\chi+2\frac{u+a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}[-\pi-]$
$4a\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\pi'-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\chi'+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\pi'=0$
$\pi\chi'-\chi\pi'$! $[-\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}\pi-\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}-]$ $\pi'\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}-\pi\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}$. $\chi\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}-\chi'\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}$. $\quad \pi\chi'-\chi\pi'$! $\pi'\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial m}-[-\pi-]\frac{\partial \chi'}{\partial m}$.
$4a$ $\quad -\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}$ $\quad \frac{\partial p}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}$ $\quad 4a$ $\quad -\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}$
$4a\frac{\partial \log(\pi\chi'-\chi\pi')}{\partial m}=\frac{\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}\chi'-\chi\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}+\pi\frac{\partial \chi'}{\partial m}-[-\pi-]\chi'\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial m}}{\pi\chi'-\chi\pi'}=-\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)+\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=-2\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial m}+\frac{u}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)$

methods.what: System of two second-order PDEs in p, q (mixed derivatives in m and η) with coefficients depending on u and a
methods.quote: $4a\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial m\partial \eta}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\frac{\partial p}{\partial \eta}-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\frac{\partial q}{\partial \eta}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial \eta}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=0$

methods.what: Linear first-order system in m satisfied by solution pairs (π, χ), obtained by substituting π, χ for the η-derivatives
methods.quote: $4a\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}+\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}\pi-\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\chi+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\pi=0$

methods.what: Abel/Liouville-type formula: logarithmic derivative of the Wronskian-like determinant πχ'−χπ' of two solutions expressed through the coefficients
methods.quote: $4a\frac{\partial \log(\pi\chi'-\chi\pi')}{\partial m}=\frac{\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial m}\chi'-\chi\frac{\partial \pi'}{\partial m}+\pi\frac{\partial \chi'}{\partial m}-[-\pi-]\chi'\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial m}}{\pi\chi'-\chi\pi'}=-\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial m}+2\frac{u-a}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)+\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}=-2\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial m}+\frac{u}{a}\frac{\partial q}{\partial m}\right)$
